item.title: [6.7] TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search.

WHY IT MATTERS

TreeFlex addresses the critical context-clutter bottleneck in ReAct-style agents by introducing a dual-role language model that dynamically manages its own search tree.
